caption: The blade of a chop saw comes down on a steel bar clamped in its jaws, and a long plume of sparks shoots out behind the blade and rains onto the floor.

sa.check: A chop saw with a steel bar clamped in its jaws.
The blade comes down onto the bar.
A long plume of sparks shoots out behind the blade.
The sparks rain down onto the floor.
The plume points away from the cut, behind the blade.
The blade meets the bar first and the plume follows.

pc.expect: The plume leaves the cut along the direction the blade's rim is moving, away from the operator's side, as one long stream that curves downward.
pc.fail: The plume points into the blade against the rim's motion; or sparks radiate equally in all directions; or the plume's direction jumps about while the saw is steady.

pc.expect: The sparks arc downward and fade before or as they reach the floor.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and gather above the saw; or hang in the air; or lie on the floor glowing like lamps for the rest of the clip; or the plume climbs without arcing down.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the blade is in the bar and stop when it lifts clear.
pc.fail: Sparks stream while the blade is above the bar; or continue after the blade has lifted; or sparks flow back into the cut.

pc.expect: Sparks are transient: each fades in flight and none accumulate; the saw and bar keep their number.
pc.fail: Sparks persist as fixed bright dots; or a glowing pile builds on the floor; or sparks appear from a point away from the cut; or a second blade appears.

pc.expect: The blade cuts into the bar along a narrow line; the bar stays clamped and the saw keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The blade passes through the bar leaving it whole; or the bar passes through the jaws; or the blade bends like rubber; or the saw changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The saw's colour, the bar and the floor stay the same apart from the cut and any scorch marks.
pc.fail: The saw changes colour; or the bar changes length or thickness away from the cut; or the floor pattern changes.
